1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.e5 c5 4.Qg4 cxd4 5.Nf3.strategy: Develops with an attack on the d4-pawn while the queen keeps g7 and e6 under fire. White is a pawn down for the moment, and Black has to meet the kingside threats before consolidating, but the compensation is doubtful.
1.e4 e6 2.d4 d5 3.e5 c5 4.Qg4 cxd4 5.Nf3.name: French Defence: Advance Variation, Nimzowitsch Gambit
